App Store Guideline Compliance Summary

  • Guideline 5.1.1(v) — In-App Account Deletion:
    ReNu-Biome supports account registration and provides full in-app account deletion. Users can navigate to More -> Account Session -> "Delete Account" (or Profile -> "Delete Account & Data"). Tapping the action presents a destructive confirmation alert. Upon user confirmation, a permanent DELETE /api/profile API call removes all user records, purges credentials from persistent storage, records an audit log, and immediately terminates the local session.
  • Guideline 3.1.5(a) & 3.2 — Physical Goods & Services Outside the App:
    ReNu-Biome does not offer digital unlockables, digital content, or in-app subscriptions. All orders and invoices represent physical bulk agricultural goods (liquid biological soil amendments, beneficial microbial inoculants, and organic crop nutrition delivered in 500 to 5,000 gallon batches by commercial tanker trucks directly to farm storage tanks) and on-field agronomy advisory services. Payments settle real-world freight and physical agricultural goods via standard commercial invoice billing and ACH, which are exempt from In-App Purchase requirements.
  • CDFA & Regulatory Compliance:
    ReNu Biome products comply with the California Department of Food and Agriculture (CDFA) Organic Input Material (OIM) standards and AAPFCO guidelines. The application operates strictly as an enterprise B2B agricultural logistics platform.
